{{Quote|This holoprojection was a gift from Queen Ressa of Drezzi to thank Darth Nyriss for her merciful treatment of the royal family when the Empire conquered their world. Her husband was executed, but the queen and her children were spared.|Sechel, to Scourge|<ref name="Revan" />}}
The resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] '''conquered''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drezzi]]<ref name="Revan" /> prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3954 BBY]].<ref name="think" /> Although the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire conquered Drezzi, defeated the [[Unidentified resistance force (Drezzi)|resistance force]], and [[Death/Legends|executed]] [[Ressa's husband|her husband]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Ressa]] of Drezzi and her [[Youngling/Legends|children]] were spared by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nyriss]]. Ressa gave Darth Nyriss a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] as a gift of thanks for sparing her own and her children's lives. Sometime later, the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sechel]] told the tale of Drezzi's fate to the Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The conquest of Drezzi was mentioned in the second chapter of the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published in [[2011]].<ref name="Revan" />
